note: Starter badge catalog for the Trophy Room (docs/specs/rewards.md). emoji is a placeholder until the commissioned art arrives.

collections.name: Loyalty
collections.blurb: For showing up, hanging out and being part of the vibe.

collections.name: Chat and Hype
collections.blurb: For the talkers, the hype crew and the chaos agents.

collections.name: Stream Moments
collections.blurb: The horror, the VR chaos, and the moments you had to be there for.

collections.name: Community
collections.blurb: For the helpers and organizers who make the place better.

collections.name: Creators
collections.blurb: For the artists, editors, meme-lords and storytellers.

collections.name: Supporters
collections.blurb: A thank-you for keeping the lights on. They show on your profile, but give no XP and never count on a leaderboard.

collections.name: Limited and Legacy
collections.blurb: Available for a short window only. When it closes, the badge is buried for good.

collections.name: Crew
collections.blurb: Mods and admins only. Earned by keeping the place safe and running.
